content.text:
Tax now rounds half-up. The two new tests pass, but the repo's normal test command doesn't currently run (details below).

**What changed**
- `src/billing/tax.py`: `tax_for` was only a placeholder (`raise NotImplementedError`), so there was no old rounding code to switch. I wrote it from scratch. It works out the tax on an integer cent amount using `Decimal` and rounds to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. A comment says to call it once per line item and add up the results, so the invoice total is never rounded.
- `tests/test_tax.py`: added a test that checks half-cent cases round up (250 cents × 1% → 3, 350 × 1% → 4) and that 249 × 1% → 2.

**Tests:** `make test-fast` fails before running any tests, and it failed the same way before my change. Two things cause it: `src` can't be imported unless the repo root is added to the import path, and `requests` isn't installed, which breaks `test_payments.py`. Running `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_tax.py` passes both tax tests. I didn't run the rest of the suite.

**Project memory:** the stored note on tax rounding still said to use banker's rounding (round-half-to-even) and never half-up. I updated it to say finance switched to half-up on 2026-10-01. The rest of the note (round each line separately, then add) is unchanged.
